description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
 Position Summary 
 
 We are seeking a collaborative and detail-oriented Software Development Engineer to help ensure the reliability, stability, and performance of our production systems.
 
 What you'll do 
 Manage incident processes to quickly resolve production issues and reduce business impact
 Partner with cross-functional teams to identify root causes and improve system stability
 Monitor system health and proactively address performance risks
 Implement automation tools to increase efficiency and reduce manual errors
 Lead post-incident reviews and implement preventive solutions
 Build strong relationships with business stakeholders for effective collaboration
 Prioritize support work based on urgency and business impact
 Maintain clear documentation of procedures, fixes, and system configurations
 










 
 Required Qualifications 
 3 - 5 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a production support, platform
 High-level proficiency in Java for backend service development and troubleshooting
 Strong experience for API development, scripting, and tooling
 Experience with Python and PostgresSQL
 Hands-on experience building or maintaining React applications used in operational or internal tooling contexts
 Proven cloud experience on Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including managed services, IAM, and networking
 Strong command of observability tooling ( Grafana, Splunk, or equivalent)
 Experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and event-driven patterns
 Demonstrated ability to lead major incidents end-to-end and facilitate post-mortems
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfort presenting to technical and non-technical audiences
 Experience with GCP services: GKE, Cloud Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud Operations Suite
 Experience with AI technologies
 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Azure-specific services: AKS, Azure Monitor
 Adept at problem solving and decision making skills
 Adept at collaboration and teamwork
 Adept at growth mindset (agility and developing yourself and others) skills
 Adept at execution and delivery (planning, delivering, and supporting) skills
 Adept at business intelligence
 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree preferred/specialized training/relevant professional qualification.
 
 
 Pay Range 
 The typical pay range for this role is:
€35,000.00 - €90,000.00   
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 01/10/2026
